Đặt các mốc chủ đầu tư công bố cạnh nhau: Putting the developer's announced milestones side by side shows the expected construction pace: basement completed and podium under construction in mid-July 2026; 5th-floor structure done in November 2026; targets of the 10th floor on December 10, 2026, the 20th floor on March 10, 2027 and topping out the 25-floor tower before April 30, 2027. So, according to plan, the floor 10 – 20 phase is expected to take about 3 months, faster than the podium phase, which is structurally more complex.
